 v_local_time1 date;
 
begin
-- if is_timezone_enabled then
 if :contracts.eff_date is not null then 
 if IS_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then 
 
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, v_local_time);

end;

Trigger.Name: CHECK_DUP_TESTID
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 currec number ;
 curtestid VARCHAR2(12) ;
begin

 currec := :system.cursor_record ;
 curtestid := :contract_tests.test_id ;
 first_record ;
 loop
 if :system.cursor_record != currec
 and :contract_tests.test_id = curtestid then
 go_record(currec) ;
 show_error('5163') ;
 raise form_trigger_failure ;
 end if ;
 exit when :system.last_record = 'TRUE' ;
 next_record ;
 end loop ;
 go_record(currec) ;
end ;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_ADDRESS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure check_address is
begin
 if :contracts.address_id is null
 then
 begin
 select address_seq.nextval
 into :contracts.address_id
 from dual;
 :CONTRACTS.ADDRESS_UPDATE_FLAG := 'N' ;
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 else
 :CONTRACTS.ADDRESS_UPDATE_FLAG := 'Y' ;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: GENERATE_CONTRACT_ID
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure generate_contract_id is
 last_contract_id VARCHAR2(9) := NULL;
begin
begin
 select max(contract_id)
 into last_contract_id
 from contracts
 where contract_id like :contracts.chapter_id ||
 :contracts.contract_type || '%';
exception
 when others then handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;
--
if last_contract_id is null
then
 :ctrl_block_1.contract_id := :contracts.chapter_id ||
 :contracts.contract_type || '0001';
else
 :ctrl_block_1.contract_id :=
 substr(last_contract_id,1,5) ||
 lpad(to_char(to_number(substr(last_contract_id,6,4))+1),4,'0');
end if;
--
end;
